answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 14835 Country: India Title: asalamualaykum, Is my wifes sister my mahram? Is my wifes mother my mahram? Please give detailed explanation. JazakAllah Khair Question: asalamualaykum, Is my wifes sister my mahram? Is my wifes mother my mahram? Please give detailed explanation. JazakAllah Khair Answer ID: 14835 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1131/923=L/1430) Sister of wife (sister in law) is non-mahram, one should observe hijab. Mother of wife (mother in law) is mahram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
